description: Record/replay script for the LJCMG CapDetail attachments iframe (frames, LJCMGClient.cs:531-621). The attachment grid lives INSIDE the iframe '#ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_attachmentEdit_iframeAttachmentList', served per state via states.<name>.frames (att1 -> frame-p1.html, att2 -> frame-p2.html); the outer page.html is the same CapDetail shell across both. Page 1 has one downloadable file row + a 'Next' pagination anchor; clicking Next (an IN-FRAME click, on.in) swaps the frame's grid to page 2 (the postback re-render). Clicking the file link (also in-frame) yields sample.bin as a browser download (suggestedFilename 'report.pdf'). A page-level 'Attachments' tab click (on with no in) exists so page vs in-frame clicks are distinguishable. No Chromium, no live traffic.

on.click: #attachmentList_gdvAttachmentList > tbody > tr.ACA_Table_Pages table.aca_pagination > tbody > tr > td:last-child > a
